[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] TierPoint provides colocation, cloud, and managed IT services from a portfolio the company and its majority owner describe as roughly 40 data centers across about 18 to 20 U.S. markets. This session traced and dated the companys ownership structure, previously recorded without a clear citation chain: institutional investor Argo Infrastructure Partners began investing in TierPoint in 2020, added a further 500 million dollars in 2022, and took a majority stake by 2024. Per Argos own December 9, 2025 press release, Argo then acquired the equity interests of most of TierPoints remaining minority shareholders, consolidating its control and bringing total capital formation under Argos ownership to 3 billion dollars since 2020. Separately, per Data Center Dynamics trade press, Apollo Global Management announced in January 2025 that it would acquire Argo Infrastructure Partners itself, adding about 6 billion dollars in assets to Apollos infrastructure platform, with closing expected in the second quarter of 2025, meaning Argos majority stake in TierPoint now sits within Apollos broader infrastructure platform. This specific row, TierPoint Milwaukee, per the operators own dedicated page for this facility, fetched fresh this session, sits at 3701 W. Burnham Street, Suite C, Milwaukee, WI 53215, and remains an active, currently operating TierPoint facility. Per Data Center Dynamics trade press fetched this session, TierPoint acquired this facility through its January 2016 purchase of Cosentry, which had itself acquired the building from Red Anvil LLC in 2014. That same trade press coverage reported this building itself, not the data center business, sold for 4.66 million dollars in an October 2021 real estate transaction, seller KCMJ Investments LLC to buyer WSP Burnham LLC, changing only the landlord. The article reported TierPoint confirmed at the time it would remain in the facility as operator after the change in landlord, consistent with the operators own current page still listing this facility as active today. This registrys TierPoint operator attribution for this row is therefore confirmed current, not stale.
